title: Onboarding Supply Schedule: Setup Units on Test-Strip Refills
content:
Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program — setup units added to a test-strip refill.

**Schedule.** The first strip refill after a newly supplied meter adds 1 unit for the new meter's control checks and setup; the first strip refill of a program activated within the last 30 days, with no earlier strip refill on it, adds 2 units; and no setup units are added otherwise.

- A program activated within the last 30 days has an activation date 30 days or fewer before today.

| Refill | Setup units |
|---|---|
| first strip refill after a newly supplied meter | 1 |
| first strip refill of a program activated 30 days ago or less, with no earlier strip refill | 2 |
| first strip refill of a program activated 31 days ago or more | 0 |
| any other strip refill | 0 |

**Cases (hypothetical).** A program's meter was shipped on 3 September and its latest strip refill on 20 August: the next strip refill adds 1 unit. A program activated 12 days ago with no strip refill yet: its first strip refill adds 2 units; had it been activated 31 days ago, it would add none.
